flash_memory_map.full_flash: ~2 MB total (approx 1 MB flash + 2 KB EEPROM for adaptations/immobiliser)
flash_memory_map.calibration_region: Separate working calibration file available in reference

checksum.type: bosch_edc16_multi_region_sum_to_zero_16bit (Rust native impl) + note on real multipoint CRC32
checksum.description: 7 refined regions across 2MB flash focused on diesel map areas: Boot/Low OS (0x00000-0x1FFFF), Main Program (0x20000-0x7FFFF), Primary Cal - Driver Wish/IQ/Timing/Rail (0x80000-0xBFFFF), Secondary Cal - Boost/VGT/EGR/Smoke (0xC0000-0xFFFFF), Extended Maps (0x100000-0x13FFFF), Adaptations (0x140000-0x17FFFF), End/Security (0x180000-0x1FFFFF). Additive 16-bit sum-to-zero is the current practical DIY path. Real production EDC16 commonly uses multipoint CRC32 (WinOLS plugin style). Auto-detect by BIN size. validate + correct fully implemented in UI.
checksum.notes: Refine exact cs_offset on your working bin: change one map byte, find the 16-bit word that compensated by the inverse amount. That is the true location for that region. Future: add CRC32 multipoint when exact C41 polynomials confirmed.

security_access.reference: Code for Device.md + planned edc16_seedkey.rs (similar to security.rs for P01)

maps_and_xdf.description: No ready XDF in reference. Auto tables use refined community-typical addresses for ZD30CRD (Driver Wish ~0x80000, IQ ~0x82000, Boost ~0xC0000, Rail ~0xC2000, VGT ~0xC4000). These are solid starting points; refine with your own bin.
maps_and_xdf.eeprom: EDC16C41 working eeprom (2 KB) - immobiliser, adaptations, coding data

notes: Matches and expands the REFERENCE_INDEX.md entry. 23710-VS43B is the specific hardware/part for GU V Wagon variant. DB entry enables auto-identification. Rust support added: CAN (ELM/ISO-TP), KWP2000, Nissan Consult II for live data + commands. Use protocol selector in UI. **Checksum regions refined** for better coverage of the maps you actually edit on the Patrol.
